extra_vocab.en: by a large amount that people can notice
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡問使用碳纖維是否會「大幅」增加生產成本。significantly 放在 increase 前面，用來詢問成本影響的幅度是否明顯。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: significantly 修飾動詞時放在動詞前或受詞後，修飾比較級時放在前面：significantly higher；形容詞要用 significant。

example.en: The new process will significantly reduce our waste each month.
example.zh: 新流程會大幅減少我們每個月的廢料。

example.en: Shipping costs are significantly higher than we expected.
example.zh: 運費明顯比我們預期的高。

example.en: The two quotes differ significantly in price and delivery time.
example.zh: 這兩份報價在價格和交貨時間上差異很大。

examples.en: Sales improved significantly after we launched the new model.
examples.zh: 推出新型號之後，銷售額明顯成長。

examples.en: The delay has significantly affected our production schedule.
examples.zh: 這次延誤已大幅影響我們的生產時程。

examples.en: Customer satisfaction rose significantly compared with last year.
examples.zh: 顧客滿意度比去年顯著提升。

confusable.diff: significant 是形容詞，significantly 是副詞。
confusable.usage: significant 修飾名詞（a significant increase），significantly 修飾動詞或形容詞（increase significantly）。

example.en: We saw a significant increase in orders last month.
example.zh: 我們上個月看到訂單明顯增加。

similar.diff: considerably 比較口語、中性，也常修飾比較級，語氣比 significantly 稍弱。

example.en: The new engine is considerably quieter than the old one.
example.zh: 新引擎比舊的安靜許多。

similar.diff: substantially 比較正式，常用在財務或數量的大幅變動。

example.en: Profits have increased substantially since the new policy began.
example.zh: 新政策開始之後，利潤大幅增加。

example.en: Fuel prices have dramatically changed our delivery costs.
example.zh: 燃料價格已大幅改變我們的運送成本。

example.en: The new version is slightly heavier than the old one.
example.zh: 新版本比舊版稍微重一點。

derived.link: significant + -ly 就是 significantly；像 important → importantly
significant 的 -ant 換成 -ance，變成名詞，像 important → importance
in-（不）+ significant，不重要的，像 incorrect、inactive

extra_vocab.en: in most cases, or when you think about the whole situation
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 generally 表示「整體來說」碳纖維比傳統鋁管貴，語氣上留有少數例外的空間，是回答成本問題時常見的保守說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: generally 放在 be 動詞後、一般動詞前，或放在句首；形容詞要用 general，不能寫 general more expensive。

example.en: Generally speaking, larger orders get a lower price per unit.
example.zh: 一般來說，訂購量越大，單價越低。

example.en: This test method is generally accepted across the industry.
example.zh: 這種測試方法在業界普遍被接受。

example.en: The new software will be generally available next month.
example.zh: 新軟體將於下個月開放一般使用者取得。

examples.en: Our customers are generally satisfied with the delivery time.
examples.zh: 我們的客戶整體而言對交貨時間感到滿意。

examples.en: We generally reply to all inquiries within two business days.
examples.zh: 我們通常會在兩個工作天內回覆所有詢問。

examples.en: Aluminum is generally cheaper than carbon fiber for large orders.
examples.zh: 大量訂購時，鋁通常比碳纖維便宜。

confusable.diff: general 是形容詞，generally 是副詞。
confusable.usage: general 修飾名詞（a general rule），generally 修飾動詞、形容詞或整個句子。

example.en: As a general rule, we ship orders within two days.
example.zh: 一般而言，我們會在兩天內出貨。

confusable.diff: generously 是「慷慨地」，拼法相近，意思無關。

example.en: The client generously offered to cover our travel costs.
example.zh: 客戶慷慨地提出負擔我們的差旅費用。

similar.diff: usually 強調習慣或經常發生；generally 強調整體上的情況。

example.en: Our staff usually arrive at the office before nine.
example.zh: 我們的員工通常在九點前到辦公室。

similar.diff: in general 常放在句首或句尾，語氣較口語，意思相同。

example.en: In general, online orders arrive faster than store orders.
example.zh: 整體來說，網路訂單比門市訂單更快送達。

example.en: Orders are typically processed within one working day.
example.zh: 訂單通常會在一個工作天內處理完成。

example.en: Our clients are mostly small businesses in the area.
example.zh: 我們的客戶大多是當地的小型企業。

derived.link: general + -ize，使變成「一般性的說法」，像 organize、realize

extra_vocab.en: something you think about when you make a decision
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 considerations 指做決定時必須考量的因素，材料成本是其中之一。key considerations 是商務簡報常用的說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「考量的因素」是可數（one of the key considerations），「仔細考慮」是不可數（give it careful consideration）；take A into consideration 的 A 放在 take 和 into 之間。

example.en: Cost and safety are the main considerations for this project.
example.zh: 成本和安全是這個專案的主要考量。

example.en: Please take the budget into consideration before ordering new equipment.
example.zh: 訂購新設備之前，請把預算納入考量。

example.en: Three suppliers are still under consideration for the contract.
example.zh: 有三家供應商仍在這份合約的考慮名單中。

example.en: Safety remains the key consideration in our design process.
example.zh: 安全仍是我們設計流程中的關鍵考量。

examples.en: Delivery time is also an important consideration for our clients.
examples.zh: 交貨時間對我們的客戶來說也是重要的考量。

examples.en: We will give your request careful consideration and reply by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們會仔細考慮您的要求，並在星期五前回覆。

examples.en: Price and quality are the two main considerations in this purchase.
examples.zh: 價格與品質是這次採購的兩大考量。

confusable.diff: considerable 是形容詞，意思是「相當大的」，拼法接近 consideration。
confusable.usage: considerable 修飾名詞（a considerable amount），不是「考慮」的意思；consideration 是名詞。

example.en: The project required a considerable amount of time and money.
example.zh: 這個專案需要相當多的時間和金錢。

confusable.diff: considerate 是形容詞，意思是「體貼的」，用來形容人。

example.en: She is a considerate manager who listens to everyone.
example.zh: 她是一位體貼的主管，會聆聽每個人的意見。

similar.diff: factor 是影響結果的因素，較中性；consideration 強調決策時必須考慮的事。

example.en: Weather is a factor that can delay our shipments.
example.zh: 天氣是可能延誤我們出貨的因素。

similar.diff: concern 是擔心的事，帶有憂慮；consideration 只是要考慮的因素。

example.en: Our main concern is the long delivery time.
example.zh: 我們主要擔心的是過長的交貨時間。

example.en: Customer safety is our first priority in every project.
example.zh: 顧客安全是我們每個專案的第一優先。

example.en: We have two options for shipping this order.
example.zh: 這筆訂單我們有兩種運送選項。

derived.link: consider 把 -ation 加上去就是 consideration，像 inform → information
consider + -able，值得被「考慮」的，也就是份量不小，像 comfortable
considerable 去掉 -le 加 -ly，變成副詞，像 reasonable → reasonably
consider + -ate，會替別人著想的，像 fortunate

senses.en: something you must think about before you decide
senses.distinguish: 可數，常用複數 considerations，常搭配 key、main。

example.en: Material cost is a major consideration for every buyer.
example.zh: 材料成本是每位買家的重要考量。

senses.en: the act of thinking carefully about something
senses.distinguish: 不可數，常見於 under consideration、Thank you for your consideration。

example.en: Thank you for your consideration of our proposal.
example.zh: 感謝您考慮我們的提案。

senses.en: care for the feelings of other people
senses.distinguish: 後面接 for + 人時，是對別人的體諒。

example.en: She showed great consideration for her new coworkers.
example.zh: 她對新同事表現出很多體諒。

extra_vocab.en: coming first, before the final or main part
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 preliminary evaluation 表示尚未完成詳細評估的初步結果，所以多出約 500 公克這個數字之後可能還會調整。

example.en: The preliminary results show that the new design works well.
example.zh: 初步結果顯示新設計運作良好。

example.en: Please send the preliminary report to the team by noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把初步報告寄給團隊。

example.en: Our preliminary estimate for the project is about fifty thousand dollars.
example.zh: 我們對這個專案的初步估價約為五萬美元。

examples.en: This is only a preliminary plan, so changes are still possible.
examples.zh: 這只是初步計畫，所以仍可能有變動。

examples.en: Attached is the preliminary schedule for next month's factory visit.
examples.zh: 附件是下個月參訪工廠的初步時程表。

examples.en: We held a preliminary meeting with two suppliers last week.
examples.zh: 上週我們和兩家供應商開了初步會議。

confusable.diff: primary 是「最主要的、首要的」，preliminary 是「初步的、之後還會修改的」。

example.en: Our primary goal is to improve product quality this year.
example.zh: 我們今年的首要目標是提升產品品質。

similar.diff: initial 指「最開始的」，不一定之後會改；preliminary 暗示之後還有正式版本。

example.en: The initial order was small, but sales grew quickly.
example.zh: 最初的訂單不大，但銷量很快成長。

similar.diff: tentative 指「暫定的」，強調還沒確定，可能會變；常用在日期與計畫。

example.en: The tentative date for the launch is the first of June.
example.zh: 產品上市的暫定日期是六月一日。

example.en: The final report will be ready by the end of the month.
example.zh: 最終報告會在月底前完成。

example.en: Please review the draft and send me your comments.
example.zh: 請檢視這份草稿並把意見寄給我。

extra_vocab.en: the distance across a circle through its center
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 the same diameter 表示鋁管與碳纖維管的外徑相同，這樣比較重量時，差別就只剩下材質與壁厚。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示尺寸時，可說 5 cm in diameter（數字在前），或 a diameter of 5 cm；不要寫成 diameter 5 cm long。

example.en: We stock tubes in several different diameters and lengths.
example.zh: 我們庫存有多種不同直徑和長度的管子。

example.en: The outer diameter of this pipe is twenty-five millimeters.
example.zh: 這根管子的外徑是二十五毫米。

example.en: Please check the inner diameter before you order the connectors.
example.zh: 訂購接頭之前，請先確認內徑。

example.en: Each wheel is about twenty centimeters in diameter.
example.zh: 每個輪子的直徑約為二十公分。

examples.en: The diameter of the tube affects both its weight and strength.
examples.zh: 管子的直徑會影響它的重量和強度。

examples.en: Please confirm the diameter and wall thickness of the tubes.
examples.zh: 請確認管子的直徑和壁厚。

examples.en: A larger diameter makes the frame stiffer but also heavier.
examples.zh: 直徑較大會讓車架更硬挺，但也更重。

confusable.diff: radius 是半徑，等於 diameter 的一半。

example.en: The radius of the circle is half of its diameter.
example.zh: 這個圓的半徑是它直徑的一半。

confusable.diff: circumference 是圓周長，是繞圓一圈的長度；diameter 是穿過圓心的長度。

example.en: Measure the circumference of the pipe with a flexible tape.
example.zh: 請用軟尺量這根管子的周長。

example.en: The thickness of the wall affects the weight of the tube.
example.zh: 管壁的厚度會影響管子的重量。

example.en: Please check the width of the door before delivery.
example.zh: 送貨之前，請先確認門的寬度。

example.en: We can cut the tubes to any length you need.
example.zh: 我們可以把管子切成您需要的任何長度。
